framing: Fixed source-estimated orientation plus yaw offset; center native geometry bounding box, fit all vertices inside12percent margin once per view; no per-material fit.
material_intervention: Same full native vertices/faces in official MeshWithPbrMaterial; one opaque texture-free material. Replace predicted Base Color/M/R/Alpha, retain geometry only; no normal/bump/displacement or native texture.
base_color_encoding: Renderer display-domain RGB constants; official renderer internally applies pow2.2 before lighting, then ACES and gamma once.
scope: 180 candidates,30 matched six-material blocks,210 metallic-flip/adjacent-roughness pairs; no new3D sampling, no training or monitoring.
limitations: Synthetic counterfactuals of one generated geometry, not exact photographic counterfactuals. Original color and appearance-only patterns are discarded. M/R controls approximate IBL reflectance, not wood/cloth semantics or calibrated BRDF truth.
